sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the closing word of Jesus' line ('all things are possible to him who ___'). No earlier card has shown that wording or points to the answer. 'Waits' and 'works' are equally plausible, so the pick comes down to guessing the wording of the line.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
